description: Deterministic infrastructure fault contracts for the maintained PostgreSQL, Kafka, Pi Worker and Cube Tool path.

cases.test: persists text but no Tool draft, then waits for the complete validated intent ACK
cases.invariant: Streaming Tool drafts never enter native commits; complete calls execute only after their validated intent is acknowledged.

cases.test: a Tool-only stream writes no draft even when its provider mutates the opening partial
cases.invariant: Provider mutation cannot insert Tool arguments into an earlier partial already delivered to Durable.

cases.test: Stop during argument generation retains text without a Tool or phantom result
cases.invariant: Stopping an incomplete call retains committed text without persisting arguments, executing the Tool or inventing a result.

cases.test: reopens a streamed request without replaying drafts or submitting the input twice
cases.invariant: Recovery resumes the original input without replaying or retaining an incomplete Tool call.

cases.test: never probes absent chat bindings, but treats a missing expected binding as unavailable
cases.invariant: Probes never allocate a VM; an expected missing binding is unavailable, not silently not-applicable.

cases.test: a return before the handoff HTTP ACK cannot regress from Worker to Cube stage
cases.invariant: A fast complete return cannot be overwritten by a later admission receipt.

cases.test: expired, wrong-boot, closed and duplicate replies never fabricate fresh health
cases.invariant: Current scope, target and deadline are required for fresh evidence; unknown transport never authorizes resource recovery.

cases.test: Projector reset discards pending acknowledgements even when the same Session is re-admitted
cases.invariant: Pending observations cannot survive Projector ownership reset as fresh acknowledgements.

cases.test: missing inventory and failed execution need exact evidence, not inferred absence
cases.invariant: Partial inventory or failed guest responses cannot authorize VM destruction or quota release.

cases.test: covers 160 due VMs without a batch truncation and bounds concurrent execution
cases.invariant: Every due physical runtime is examined without a 16-item truncation or unbounded concurrent requests.

cases.test: lost guest replies do not stop log probes, and replacement rejects old binding replies
cases.invariant: Missing guest replies do not block publication, native drain or future log-path probes; replaced bindings reject late evidence.

cases.test: rejects a machine rebind if release intent commits while its row lock is awaited
cases.invariant: A pending machine release wins over a stale target lookup; rebinding checks a fresh snapshot after the machine lock.

cases.test: binds a missing Workspace to its owner's machine without changing history identity or accepted Runs
cases.invariant: Binding replay cannot duplicate or retarget the operation; native Session/model identity and previously accepted Run snapshots remain unchanged.

cases.test: keeps sweeping while remote retirement stalls and drains both loops without overlap
cases.invariant: A stalled remote stop cannot stall lease scanning; drain prevents another cleanup claim.

cases.test: retires an expired Run on a healthy Worker without stopping its other Session
cases.invariant: Both initial expiry selection and final retirement use PG time, independent of API clock skew.

cases.test: bounds stalled probes and a lost probe ACK does not poison later semantic writes
cases.invariant: At most one probe is outstanding per physical Session; a probe has no semantic commit to recover.

cases.test: shares Session path evidence across Lanes while rejecting replay, stale and future probes
cases.invariant: A replay or stale probe cannot refresh liveness or create an active execution scope.

cases.test: authenticates observations against projected scopes and closes all Lanes on writer seal
cases.invariant: Tenant, partition and owner checks fence phase observations; a writer seal closes all sibling observations.

cases.test: delivers activity after the snapshot without advancing sequence and suppresses post-terminal observations
cases.invariant: Transient activity cannot alter transcript sequence or reopen a terminal turn.

cases.test: expires unaccepted image drafts and rejects completion after a claim is removed
cases.invariant: Expired drafts release image pins; a revoked upload cannot become a ready input after a late external reply.

cases.test: accepts more than four files and 32 MiB, and pins an image while final publication is pending
cases.invariant: Streaming uploads exceed former product quotas while image reachability is pinned before final publication; GC cannot remove an active source.

cases.test: refuses symlinked upload directories and destination files
cases.invariant: Upload placement cannot follow a substituted directory or destination link outside the authorized root.

cases.test: prepares immutable input images without an Agent Tool and waits for guest cancellation (cancel=true)
cases.invariant: Input preparation is fenced independently of Agent Tool execution and remains tracked until guest cancellation finishes.

cases.test: cancels one waiting Lane immediately without interrupting a sibling's read
cases.invariant: Cancelling a cold history waiter does not cancel the shared progress read or a sibling.

cases.test: checks ownership even for cached positions and does not cache failed reads
cases.invariant: Previously observed progress cannot authorize a retired owner or cache a failed read.

cases.test: rolls back a timed-out native Session lock and replays the same offset once
cases.invariant: Server lock timeout leaves native history and projection positions unchanged; redelivery after release applies once.

cases.test: cancels long projection statements on the server and restores transaction settings
cases.invariant: A timed-out SQL statement rolls back preceding writes and transaction-local timeout settings.

cases.test: does not put unrelated partition handlers behind a pending owner-delivery ACK
cases.invariant: A blocked delivery in one partition does not serialize unrelated partition handlers.

cases.test: projects a combined invocation before dispatch commit and never reissues it on history replay
cases.invariant: Native intent projects before effect admission; replay never reissues the combined command.

cases.test: does not dispatch the combined command across a projection failure
cases.invariant: Failed native projection cannot commit or dispatch its Tool command.

cases.test: does not dispatch the combined command across a commit failure
cases.invariant: An unconfirmed Kafka dispatch commit cannot issue a Tool effect.

cases.test: does not dispatch the combined command across a rebalance failure
cases.invariant: Lost partition ownership after commit does not dispatch a new effect.

cases.test: does not dispatch the combined command across a sealed failure
cases.invariant: An invocation after its scope seal cannot dispatch a Tool command.

cases.test: rejects an expired owner at the final Run write without starting the Agent
cases.invariant: Final admission checks current PG time after locks; an expired lease cannot start the Agent or leave partial owner state.

cases.test: overlaps distinct claims but preserves capacity, same-Session order and the seal barrier
cases.invariant: Local pending reservations bound overlapping claims without a PG slot counter; successors still wait for closure.

cases.test: settles cancellation beside native projection without replaying stop (SQL abort=false)
cases.invariant: Cancellation lifecycle locks remain compatible with the native Record's Turn foreign key, so neither side deadlocks.

cases.test: settles cancellation beside native projection without replaying stop (SQL abort=true)
cases.invariant: A certified cancellation-settlement SQL abort retries only that transaction, never the external stop or Agent Loop.

cases.test: rolls readiness and family closure back together and ignores duplicate seals
cases.invariant: A failed seal commit cannot release the next Lane task or decrement the family count; replay decrements once.

cases.test: does not lose readiness when acceptance races closure: input-first
cases.invariant: Input acceptance and seal projection serialize on the Lane row and cannot leave a committed follow-up permanently waiting.

cases.test: does not lose readiness when acceptance races closure: seal-first
cases.invariant: Input waiting behind a seal transaction observes the committed closure and becomes ready without another notification.

cases.test: keeps every active Lane of one physical Pi Session on its owner Worker
cases.invariant: A ready main Lane cannot acquire a new owner until the old sibling's final seal commits.

cases.test: discards an interrupted snapshot and applies only the complete replacement
cases.invariant: A partial snapshot never appears in the browser or leaks into the replacement snapshot.

cases.test: deduplicates the same command and reuses one execution promise
cases.invariant: Duplicate delivery does not execute one Agent command twice.

cases.test: retains the high-water fencing token after a pre-start release
cases.invariant: A released task cannot reuse its execution reference under a retired Session owner.

cases.test: does not admit a larger epoch or an unknown Run directly from an append
cases.invariant: A record cannot install its own authority or bypass the PG-issued publication scope.

cases.test: keeps an in-flight snapshot when committed content is evicted
cases.invariant: Terminal projection unloads shared live-tail memory without invalidating an in-flight browser snapshot.

cases.test: co-commits the first native floor and replays after after_commit failure
cases.invariant: A lost PG COMMIT reply preserves the first recovery floor and idempotent native projection.

cases.test: co-commits the first native floor and replays after before_commit failure
cases.invariant: First native data and its recovery floor roll back together, and retry cannot skip the prefix.

cases.test: keeps an active assignment alive while the Control Plane process is killed and replaced
cases.invariant: Control Plane process replacement does not revoke a healthy Agent Loop.

cases.test: uses PostgreSQL to reject an old socket after reconnecting through another replica
cases.invariant: A stale Worker Control Channel cannot reclaim current ownership.

cases.test: retires an abandoned pre-provision request without creating a Cube
cases.invariant: A Control Plane failure before provisioning cannot leak a requested development machine.

cases.test: fences an expired replica before a surviving owner stays Ready
cases.invariant: A replacement Sandbox control fences the expired owner before serving its Workspace runtime.

cases.test: leaves an uncertain handoff running without replaying or quarantining it
cases.invariant: An ambiguous Tool transport never blindly replays an arbitrary command.

cases.test: separates compute on one Workspace and keeps each binding's explicit cwd
cases.invariant: Expiring a child's independent compute scope keeps the shared Volume and the active parent's runtime; each binding uses its own frozen cwd.

cases.test: waits for routing revocation and preserves binding/quota if publication fails
cases.invariant: Agent cancellation revokes routing without stopping Cube processes; publication failure retains metadata and VM quota.

cases.test: fails every shared binding even when quarantine publication fails (true)
cases.invariant: A lost shared VM closes every binding and local admission even when closure publication is unavailable.

cases.test: waits for the live Cube activation before purging POSIX Workspace data
cases.invariant: Workspace bytes are not deleted while a live Cube still owns the Volume.

cases.test: replays seal projection without duplicating its live terminal or execution closure
cases.invariant: Seal projection replay cannot duplicate a terminal or repeat execution closure; closure precedes publication.

cases.test: stops a retired partition handler after a PG await, before UI or Tool delivery
cases.invariant: A no-longer-current consumer handler cannot continue live or Tool delivery after its pending PG operation completes.

cases.test: closes queued materialization before shutdown releases physical capacity
cases.invariant: Broker shutdown rejects pending VM creation before freeing existing capacity; it never launches the waiter during teardown.

cases.test: a lost commit acknowledgement cannot start an effect
cases.invariant: A Tool command cannot dispatch until Kafka confirms its monotonic commit boundary.

cases.test: replays an unfinished display prefix without executing commands below the committed dispatch boundary
cases.invariant: Rebuilding volatile display state does not replay already committed Tool commands.

cases.test: does not publish a running command's late result after a seal
cases.invariant: Completing guest work after closure cannot publish a usable native Tool result.

cases.test: reaps only claimed tenant/object pairs when tenants share an object ID
cases.invariant: Image cleanup mutates only the tenant/object identities it locked, preserving another tenant's unexpired object.

cases.test: retires the image-adapter reply wait after publication fails without an unhandled rejection
cases.invariant: Failed publication retires the pending image-adapter callback without crashing unrelated Worker families.

cases.test: observes early reply failure while publication is pending and never republishes the Tool
cases.invariant: Early reply rejection stays observed until command publication settles and never triggers an effect replay.

cases.test: rejects progress on the final-only Kafka reply transport
cases.invariant: Observation-only progress cannot enter the final-result Kafka transport.

cases.test: closing one worker does not hand abandoned replies to another worker
cases.invariant: A replacement Worker cannot attach an old operation's replies to a new Tool call.

cases.test: accounts for adopted machines above a lowered limit before admitting new work
cases.invariant: Existing adopted machines count against a lowered capacity; new work remains queued until a physical slot is free.

cases.test: HTTP releases the transaction: another replica skips its lease while claim and Run admission finish
cases.invariant: Provider HTTP holds no business transaction or row lock; one current note-sync claim does not block claim changes or ordinary Run admission.

cases.test: reads back an applied create whose response was lost
cases.invariant: An uncertain remote create remains pending; marker readback recovers the applied note without repeating its creation in the tested lost-reply case.

cases.test: periodic verification repairs a late stale remote write even when PG versions were equal
cases.invariant: Local claim fencing rejects a stale acknowledgement, and periodic remote verification repairs its late external write even after PG considered the latest version synced.

cases.test: checks expiry after waiting for the acknowledgement row lock
cases.invariant: Synchronization acknowledgement uses PG decision time after locking; a lease that expires while waiting cannot confirm remote output.

cases.test: failed uploads stay unpublishable and interrupted cleanup is repeatable
cases.invariant: Failed uploads cannot be retained; cleanup claims survive remote deletion failure.

cases.test: protects uploads until their Run is sealed, including the unprojected Kafka interval
cases.invariant: Kafka-acknowledged but unprojected images remain protected by their unsealed source Run.

cases.test: serializes cleanup claims with new native references
cases.invariant: A deleting attachment cannot gain a canonical native reference.

cases.test: missing and cross-tenant images fail explicitly without substituting a mutable file
cases.invariant: A hash or tenant mismatch never becomes a successful native image.

cases.test: cold public SessionStorage reads reconstruct exact images while PG stores only references (user)
cases.invariant: Cold reads and independent native Fork history retain the exact image bytes.

cases.test: rejects an oversized record without poisoning another Session's publication
cases.invariant: Oversized individual publications fail before entering the bounded publication queue.

cases.test: rejects edit when Worker admission holds the affected Run without deadlocking
cases.invariant: An admitted/locked Run cannot have its input rewritten by a pending edit.

cases.test: rejects cancel when Worker admission holds the affected Run without deadlocking
cases.invariant: Pending cancellation cannot retire a Run whose admission already won.

cases.test: rejects move when Worker admission holds the affected Run without deadlocking
cases.invariant: A locked queue neighbor cannot be reordered under an active admission.

cases.test: recovers a consumed promotion after a lost reply and API restart without duplicate delivery
cases.invariant: Canonical input consumption resolves a lost HTTP reply without executing the queued source.

cases.test: restores unconsumed promotion only after the target seal (reply lost=true)
cases.invariant: A missing reply alone cannot restore a queued source; an absent input plus projected seal can.

cases.test: orders promotions to one Run across API replicas while an earlier reply is pending
cases.invariant: Promotions to the same target preserve accepted delivery order across replicas.

cases.test: stops new promotion deliveries during shutdown and resumes persisted work after restart
cases.invariant: Shutdown starts no further deliveries and restart finds the remaining durable controls.

cases.test: deduplicates concurrent replicas and rejects a competing stale queue mutation
cases.invariant: Concurrent API replicas cannot repeat a queue operation or silently overwrite a stale edit.

cases.test: fails a large return explicitly after one execution, preserving its prior effects
cases.invariant: A completed oversized workflow return becomes an explicit bounded error without repeating effects.

cases.test: a newer committed heartbeat wins over an older in-flight negative read
cases.invariant: An older lookup cannot revoke ownership confirmed by a newer committed renewal.

cases.test: shares fresh renewal evidence without extending the one-second revocation window
cases.invariant: Sharing heartbeat evidence does not slow periodic PG revocation observation.

cases.test: missing renewal revokes only its reported family and cannot be revived
cases.invariant: Missing renewal retires the reported family while retaining other families; later replies cannot revive it.

cases.test: fails all affected observers on a PG read error
cases.invariant: A failed batch read fails closed for every owner in that observation.

cases.test: does not apply a late query to a closed or newly opened observer
cases.invariant: Closing a lease observer prevents stale reads from affecting a later local incarnation.

cases.test: cuts over complete logs, COW Forks, live Turn bindings and image references without body rewrites
cases.invariant: An unsettled Session prevents schema cutover; settled cutover retains immutable bodies and never resurrects deleted Turn bindings.

cases.test: restores direct Steer acknowledged but unconsumed when its target ends (failed=true)
cases.invariant: A Worker acknowledgement never retires input; target closure restores unconsumed input without replaying its Run.

cases.test: retires direct Steer only after canonical consumption even when its HTTP reply is lost
cases.invariant: Canonical input evidence wins over missing transport acknowledgement and prevents fallback execution.

cases.test: preserves direct Steer reconciliation against a late delivery outcome (restored-success)
cases.invariant: A late Worker reply cannot overwrite a sealed-target restoration decision.

cases.test: deduplicates simultaneous direct Steer acceptance and rejects locked targets without orphaned input
cases.invariant: Direct Steer acceptance is atomic and idempotent under target locks and concurrent API replicas.

cases.test: Steer admission remains compatible with concurrent Tool binding foreign keys
cases.invariant: Input acceptance does not deadlock with active Tool binding foreign-key checks.

cases.test: closes admission before draining and emits the seal before opening a new writer
cases.invariant: Ingress closes old admission before draining and a successor cannot pass the ordered seal.

cases.test: rejects a PG admission snapshot overtaken by a projected seal even without cached Run state
cases.invariant: A delayed PG grant cannot reopen a scope after its closure completed.

cases.test: stops queued data after an uncertain append but still permits the closing seal
cases.invariant: Unknown semantic commit stops queued data while preserving ordered closure.

cases.test: uses projected closure after a lost seal ACK without leaving the next writer blocked
cases.invariant: PG canonical seal evidence releases a successor despite a lost producer ACK.

cases.test: refuses later routing after binding closure, including dispatcher replacement
cases.invariant: Durable routing closure rejects later Tool handoffs after dispatcher replacement without cancelling previously accepted processes.

cases.test: does not resurrect a deleted route after an older read completes
cases.invariant: A late binding read cannot reopen a deleted route.

cases.test: discards both delayed bootstrap and event reads after assignment replacement
cases.invariant: Old snapshots cannot repopulate a new partition owner.

cases.test: an old publication retry still installs current deletion before its Kafka send
cases.invariant: An old unsent open reference cannot hide a current PG revocation.

cases.test: coalesces changes arriving during a read and never publishes an obsolete snapshot
cases.invariant: Queue presentation never regresses after a newer committed change.

cases.test: retains one wake arriving during an in-flight Session read
cases.invariant: A control change during reconciliation is not lost.

cases.test: waits for a known retry deadline without polling the database each tick
cases.invariant: Idle timers do not scan PG and known retries remain scheduled.

cases.test: shares warm lookups and rejects late cache installation after a family change
cases.invariant: A stale Subagent read cannot overwrite a newer family view.

cases.test: keeps bounded references when bodies are evicted and retires only consumed input
cases.invariant: Evicting a body cannot discard durable unconsumed Agent input.

cases.test: pins quarantine to the physical target and rejects late identity rewrites
cases.invariant: A delayed old VM quarantine cannot rewrite its replacement identity or close replacement bindings.

cases.test: keeps send slots independent from a slow publication and a slow cleanup, then drains cleanup batches
cases.invariant: One slow Session publication or cleanup cannot block other send slots, expired local claims are not duplicated, and cleanup drains multiple bounded batches.

cases.test: discards delayed peer success across assignment replacement
cases.invariant: Old readiness replies cannot survive local ownership replacement; unready partitions remain queued.

cases.test: expires old success during a hung check and discards success after close
cases.invariant: A stalled readiness check cannot indefinitely authorize new Run admission.

cases.test: loads only owned binding pages before applying capacity limits
cases.invariant: Foreign partition payloads do not consume owner bootstrap row or byte budgets.

cases.test: keeps the last revision after waiting behind a concurrent Session mutation
cases.invariant: Transaction coalescing retains the post-lock revision so concurrent input invalidations cannot hide the final state.

cases.test: does not notify duplicate Subagent upserts, but emits actual update and deletion
cases.invariant: A conflicting no-op INSERT never publishes an imaginary source mutation.

cases.test: recovers acknowledged Steer scopes and wakes them for canonical consumption without idle reads
cases.invariant: An HTTP ACK cannot retire pending native input; cold recovery and canonical wakes still reconcile it.

cases.test: does not reuse a coalescing identity across commit, rollback or a restored reference
cases.invariant: Retained or logically restored references cannot collide with a new transaction; connection reuse and savepoint rollback clear temporary identity.

cases.test: rejects false Content-Digest and publishes no ready metadata
cases.invariant: A declared content digest is verified against the actual stream before ready metadata is published.

cases.test: streams a 65 MiB file, rejects truncation and removes a cancelled partial file
cases.invariant: Truncated, overlong or cancelled transfers leave no partial published file, including above the former upload size limit.

cases.test: resolves the upload owner before consuming bytes and never replays a consumed stream on a late redirect
cases.invariant: Ownership is resolved before byte consumption; a later redirect never implicitly replays a consumed upload stream.

cases.test: uses current heap/RSS with a fresh off-thread limit and rejects stale samples
cases.invariant: An unlimited cgroup cannot suppress all claims; real physical memory pressure and stale evidence still stop new-family admission.

cases.test: streams only upload routes while preserving bounded internal binary publications
cases.invariant: Removing upload body limits cannot turn internal native publication frames into unparsed streams or remove their transport envelope.

cases.test: terminates a streamed PUT whose complete body is accepted without a receipt
cases.invariant: A stalled receipt cannot renew upload claims indefinitely; progressing transfers retain their lifetime.

cases.test: cancels a GET after headers while the response body is stalled
cases.invariant: Cancellation closes an S3 body even after HTTP headers have resolved.

cases.test: streams with backpressure, validates the complete hash and closes on early consumer failure
cases.invariant: Consumer failure/early return never certifies an incomplete image and closes its source.

cases.test: uses PG time for cancellation claim/retry under clock skew (-60000)
cases.invariant: PG due time, claims and retries remain correct under application clock skew and concurrent dispatch.

cases.test: does not await slow presentation reads or block another watched Session
cases.invariant: Disposable queue reads cannot hold ordered projection or another watched Session.

cases.test: bounds outstanding reads through reset and resynchronizes capacity overflow
cases.invariant: Owner changes retain read-slot bounds and discard old completions; overflow requests resynchronization.

cases.test: pages unbounded queues without mixing revisions or reading all input bodies
cases.invariant: Paging never mixes queue orders or limits the count of durable inputs.

cases.test: terminates slow disposable reads without blocking the authority pool
cases.invariant: Display queries have server deadlines and separate connection capacity from authority mutations.

cases.test: does not certify an overlapping edit (verify-first)
cases.invariant: A verification result cannot certify a mutation still running or completed after its start.

cases.test: retires routing without a Cube receipt and preserves a sibling with the same binding ID
cases.invariant: Routing retirement requires closure, isolates the exact Run even with a shared binding ID, and requires no Cube process receipt.

cases.test: closes workflow channels only for the closed fact, even if an older reference loaded revocation
cases.invariant: Only the closed Kafka fact closes workflow orchestration; a newer PG revocation seen through an older fact is not a workflow command.

cases.test: preserves recoverable VM bindings across controller shutdown until physical evidence closes them
cases.invariant: Controller ownership loss preserves capsule-backed VM state/bindings for verified adoption; actual physical uncertainty still closes them atomically.

cases.test: preserves recoverable VM bindings across controller expiry until physical evidence closes them
cases.invariant: Controller ownership loss preserves capsule-backed VM state/bindings for verified adoption; actual physical uncertainty still closes them atomically.

cases.test: adopts a binding through durable Outbox metadata while publication is unavailable
cases.invariant: Verified VM adoption and confirmed binding retirement survive notification outages through durable Outbox propagation.

cases.test: retries pending ordered closure without quarantining or partially restoring a shared VM
cases.invariant: Pending ordered closure neither quarantines a verified shared VM nor exposes partial local binding restoration.

cases.test: cancels the exact invocation even after new-command routing has closed
cases.invariant: Routing revocation blocks new work without blocking idempotent cancellation of an existing operation.

cases.test: bounds an unavailable cancellation endpoint without fabricating stopping or deleting a VM
cases.invariant: Executor communication failure never authorizes VM deletion or shell replay.

cases.test: keeps abnormal-retirement cancellation address durable after binding deletion
cases.invariant: Durable cleanup intent survives Worker loss and routing-row retirement without a process-stop receipt table.

cases.test: cancels only the Bash process group (separate session=true)
cases.invariant: Normal Agent cancellation preserves independent setsid processes rather than killing the whole operation cgroup.

cases.test: leaves a completed background launch alive when a later Bash is cancelled
cases.invariant: Esc targets unfinished Tools, never background services left by completed calls.

cases.test: settles Stop's in-flight Steer by canonical consumption (consumed=false)
cases.invariant: An unconsumed Steer survives Stop as a paused input and cannot execute after service reconstruction.

cases.test: settles Stop's in-flight Steer by canonical consumption (consumed=true)
cases.invariant: Canonical consumption wins a Stop race; consumed input is not restored or executed again.

cases.test: retains immutable allocation authorization and recovers uncapsuled creation after owner replacement
cases.invariant: Creation authorization and configuration survive controller loss; closure is irreversible and late completion cannot reopen the resource.

cases.test: closes unissued allocations without fabricating legacy absence (legacy=false)
cases.invariant: Closing before authorization blocks later materialization without inferring physical absence from an inventory miss.

cases.test: closes unissued allocations without fabricating legacy absence (legacy=true)
cases.invariant: Historical missing allocation identity never becomes invented absence or quota release.

cases.test: recovers a lost creation reply by the original allocation identity without another physical create
cases.invariant: Lost creation replies resolve by the original allocation, without allocating another VM.

cases.test: closes an unregistered allocation before accepting a delayed creation
cases.invariant: A delayed create cannot reopen a previously closed allocation.

cases.test: requires durable allocation closure even after a retry reports a preflight rejection
cases.invariant: Local preflight rejection cannot release an earlier uncertain same-ID allocation; closure and physical confirmation remain required.

cases.test: renews its owner and serves another Workspace while a workspace row stays locked
cases.invariant: A blocked resource cannot revoke a healthy controller or block unrelated Workspace lifecycle work.

cases.test: renews its owner and serves another Workspace while a terminal row stays locked
cases.invariant: Owner renewal does not depend on terminal resource-row maintenance.

cases.test: releases owner locks and retires a connection after the PG whole-transaction deadline
cases.invariant: PG terminates overlong lifecycle transactions, frees ownership locks and retires the failed connection.

cases.test: applies the Workflow outcome to the actual next Pi sampling boundary: unknown
cases.invariant: Unknown Workflow effects prevent a second model request without shell replay.

cases.test: applies the Workflow outcome to the actual next Pi sampling boundary: socket-lost
cases.invariant: An unconfirmed Workflow connection close is a typed infrastructure failure.

cases.test: applies the Workflow outcome to the actual next Pi sampling boundary: business-error
cases.invariant: Ordinary script errors cannot be mistaken for infrastructure loss by their text.

cases.test: keeps native pre-start and in-flight interruption distinct: tool_cancelled
cases.invariant: Interruption after native execution may have effects; only explicit before-start cancellation proves no execution.

cases.test: does not expose a projected but unacknowledged commit, then rejects uncertain ownership
cases.invariant: Projection visibility cannot turn an unacknowledged publication into adopted native state; ambiguous ownership refuses further commits.

cases.test: keeps proved refusal usable and rejects conflicting projection bytes atomically
cases.invariant: Certified pre-enqueue refusal preserves sequence; conflicting duplicate bodies cannot change native state.

cases.test: keeps long native document tails bounded after cold reopen without changing native delta counts
cases.invariant: Derived document checkpoints bound cold reconstruction without changing native history or delta counts.

cases.test: retains acknowledged batches while projection is paused and reads only the requested cold suffix
cases.invariant: ACKed progress remains available through PG lag and cold reads remain scoped to the requested suffix.

cases.test: validates warm native writes without per-commit PostgreSQL reads
cases.invariant: Ordinary warm native commits do not add per-Step PG receipts.

cases.test: externalizes every image in real Harness submissions, Tool results and copied documents
cases.invariant: Native images remain immutable references across new record and document locations and cold decoding.

cases.test: keeps task and result origins when cleanup runs under a later admitted Turn
cases.invariant: A cleanup owner cannot reassign the original task/result provenance.

cases.test: shares one acknowledged native writer with paused PG projection, closes one scope independently, and cold restores
cases.invariant: One physical writer serves sibling Conversations and preserves acknowledged native state during scoped close and cold restore.

cases.test: covers display only after its referenced native commit and retains immutable borrowed tails
cases.invariant: Display coverage requires its committed native sequence and cannot mutate an existing snapshot.

cases.test: replays a native prefix idempotently after consumer replacement
cases.invariant: Native projection redelivery preserves one exact canonical commit.

cases.test: rejects late native writes at the PG boundary after a seal (drained=false)
cases.invariant: A sealed writer cannot append late native state.

cases.test: restores an interrupted unsafe Tool without replay and waits for the recovered cloud grant before sampling
cases.invariant: Native recovery never replays unsafe Tool effects and cannot request a model before PG-authorized binding.

cases.test: co-commits operation cancellation with native abort and adopts native late-result semantics
cases.invariant: Ordered physical cancellation accompanies native abort; late physical results never overwrite that settlement.

cases.test: executes a remote Tool only with the native post-validation intent and keeps secrets outside storage
cases.invariant: One native execute checkpoint authorizes the exact validated remote arguments without persisting model credentials.

cases.test: leaves invalid arguments to native Pi validation without preparing or dispatching an effect
cases.invariant: Native validation failure does not prepare or dispatch external effects.

cases.test: re-admits the same Run after closure and preserves Stop (none)
cases.invariant: Replacement retains logical Run/Turn identity, waits for old closure and rejects stale owner callbacks.

cases.test: re-admits the same Run after closure and preserves Stop (before_seal)
cases.invariant: A Stop racing old-owner closure is preserved for the replacement owner without consuming the queued input.

cases.test: re-admits the same Run after closure and preserves Stop (after_seal)
cases.invariant: A Stop after recovery closure cannot be lost between queued and admitted native ownership.

cases.test: withdraws exactly Stop's queue cut, retaining uploads and lost-response recovery
cases.invariant: Repeated Stop returns the original unconsumed queue cut with uploads without withdrawing newly accepted messages.

cases.test: returns every page in edited order and isolates repeated acknowledgements
cases.invariant: All withdrawn pages preserve edited order and remain recoverable after lost acknowledgement.

cases.test: settles Stop's in-flight Steer by canonical consumption (consumed=true)
cases.invariant: Consumed Steer remains history and is not returned to the composer.

cases.test: settles Stop's in-flight Steer by canonical consumption (consumed=false)
cases.invariant: Unconsumed Steer returns only after ordered native closure proves nonconsumption.

cases.test: executes one native post-validation handoff and releases the model permit during the tool wait
cases.invariant: A remote Tool wait does not hold a model permit or create a second handoff.

cases.test: decides the project verification reminder from native progress and consumes it only once
cases.invariant: Verification is derived from native history at yield and its continuation cannot duplicate after recovery.

cases.test: copies native fork document policies without carrying execution or task state
cases.invariant: Independent forks honor native document cutoff/current semantics without copying execution grants.

cases.test: retains a conservative Run budget floor across duplicate checkpoint and abort writes
cases.invariant: Recovery cannot refill finite Run budgets; abort-mark duplicates do not consume another native intent.

cases.test: keeps child supervision across Tool completion and applies native parent reply
cases.invariant: The native generation owns delegated Conversations: returning a blocked Tool permits a parent reply, while parent abort still cancels child work.

cases.test: keeps child supervision across Tool completion and applies native parent abort
cases.invariant: The native generation owns delegated Conversations: returning a blocked Tool permits a parent reply, while parent abort still cancels child work.

cases.test: reads a running native Tool with assistant coverage=true while its result is absent
cases.invariant: Plain conversation reads show the committed native Tool execute checkpoint without waiting for its final result or creating another Tool ledger.

cases.test: recovers native Compaction at summarize under the new Run grant
cases.invariant: Recovered native Compaction uses its committed Task identity only after a fresh cloud grant; Stop cannot dispatch a held model request.

cases.test: recovers native Compaction at retry under the new Run grant
cases.invariant: Recovered native Compaction uses its committed Task identity only after a fresh cloud grant; Stop cannot dispatch a held model request.

cases.test: recovers native Compaction at stop under the new Run grant
cases.invariant: Recovered native Compaction uses its committed Task identity only after a fresh cloud grant; Stop cannot dispatch a held model request.

cases.test: associates terminal-only Entries after snapshot loss (prior partial=false)
cases.invariant: Dropped start events cannot lose or shift sampling completion identity.

cases.test: keeps the old recovered partial outside the next request's completion
cases.invariant: An old interrupted partial cannot consume the replacement request identity.

cases.test: uses the pending request for native retry progress preceding its terminal-only Entry
cases.invariant: Retry progress belongs to the request whose native terminal has not been displayed yet.

cases.test: holds exclusive exclusion across utility exit and releases after holder SIGKILL
cases.invariant: A live filesystem callback owns exclusion independently of the acquisition utility; process death releases its descriptor.

cases.test: keeps exclusive filesystem exclusion while a callback continues after PG connection loss
cases.invariant: PG connection loss cannot let a new filesystem callback overlap the old holder.

cases.test: rejects a exclusive waiter whose locked envelope was replaced
cases.invariant: A waiter on a retired inode cannot mutate a successor Volume envelope.

cases.test: reads only navigation bodies but preserves the complete Tool-heavy prefix in a paged Fork
cases.invariant: Navigation omits unrelated Tool payloads while an independent Fork preserves the full selected native prefix.

cases.test: backfills and rebuilds navigation without coercing native NUL or surrogate text
cases.invariant: Index backfill/rebuild leaves canonical JSON text exact and refuses outdated metadata writes.

cases.test: reads a running native Tool with assistant coverage=false while its result is absent
cases.invariant: A durable executing Tool can be queried before display coverage without replaying uncovered assistant text.

cases.test: refuses invalid Subagent task identity before publishing: legacy-call
cases.invariant: An invalid Tool identity is refused before Kafka and cannot poison the Session writer.

cases.test: holds shared exclusion across utility exit and releases after holder SIGKILL
cases.invariant: A killed shared holder releases lifecycle exclusion without a PG lease or stale-lock deletion.

cases.test: keeps credentials filesystem exclusion while a callback continues after PG connection loss
cases.invariant: PG loss cannot release credential-file exclusion while an older callback continues.

cases.test: rejects a shared waiter whose locked envelope was replaced
cases.invariant: Shared access cannot proceed on an envelope replaced while acquisition was pending.

cases.test: rejects a credential waiter whose inner lock inode was replaced
cases.invariant: Credential waiters validate the inner as well as outer inode before mutation.

cases.test: permits actual browsing, another upload and credential updates during an upload, but excludes deletion
cases.invariant: Concurrent ordinary operations retain exclusive deletion admission until all existing callbacks settle.

cases.test: publishes identical concurrent uploads once and rejects conflicting content without overwrite
cases.invariant: Shared transfer admission preserves complete non-overwriting placement and content identity.

cases.test: turn retries a lost ACK but permits an intentional repeat after confirmation
cases.invariant: An unchanged ordinary-send retry reuses the accepted input identity; a confirmed intentional repeat remains possible.
